---
title: "DataScraping"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(polite)
library(chromote)

robotstxt::paths_allowed("http://ufcstats.com/statistics/fighters?char=a")

url <- read_html_live("http://ufcstats.com/statistics/fighters?char=a")

table <- html_nodes(url, css = "table")

fighterdata <- html_table(table, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)[[1]]

for(i in letters){
  url <- str_c("http://ufcstats.com/statistics/fighters?char=", i, "&page=all")
  fighterdatatemp <- read_html_live(url) |>
    html_nodes(css = "table") |>
    html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  bind_rows(fighterdata, fighterdatatemp)
  fighterdatatemp <- fighterdatatemp[[1]]
  fighterdata <- bind_rows(fighterdata, fighterdatatemp)
}

ft_in_to_in <- function(str){
  feet <- str_extract(str, "^\\d' ")
  inches <- parse_number(str_remove(str, feet))
  feet <- parse_number(str_remove(feet, "' "))
  str <- 12*feet + inches
}

ft_in_to_in(fighterdataclean$Ht.)

fighterdataclean <- fighterdata |>
  select(-Belt) |>
  filter(!is.na(Last)) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "--", NA_character_)),
         Ht. = ifelse(is.na(Ht.), "0' 0\"", Ht.),
         ht_inches = ft_in_to_in(Ht.),
         Ht. = ifelse(str_detect(Ht., "0' 0\""), NA_character_, Ht.),
         ht_inches = ifelse(str_detect(Ht., "0' 0\""), NA_character_, ht_inches),
         reach_inches = parse_number(Reach),
         weight_lbs = parse_number(Wt.),
         across(W:D, parse_number),
         num_fights = W + L + D,
         win_pct = W / num_fights) |>
  select(-c(Ht., Wt., Reach))
```
